about: Automatic fixes for misreads that came up again and again in reviewed rebuilds (review/*/ocr-corrections.json). Applied by rebuild_slides.py right after OCR, before the reviewed corrections (which always win). Every fix is recorded on the line (autofix) and shown on the OCR review sheets, so it is still checked by eye. Add a rule only when the same misread was corrected by eye in more than one place and the fix can't be wrong in any context. A line starting with 。 is a bullet, '=' when only a number follows (a formula), and is dropped before a labelled number.

cjk_on_latin_page.note: On a page whose text is >= 85% Latin, a line made only of 1-3 Chinese characters or full-width marks is an icon, arrow or rule read as Chinese (118 of 120 such lines were deleted by eye in the 2020 decks; the other two were '之' = '2'). A lone 其 between numbers is ×, a lone 二 is =; a line starting with 。 or *。 is a bullet.
